nodes.name: Search Problem Formulation
nodes.description: Formulating a problem for search as states, actions, a transition model, a goal test, and path costs, enabling systematic solution finding.

nodes.name: Uninformed Search
nodes.description: Search strategies using no domain knowledge, including breadth-first, depth-first, and uniform-cost search, differing in completeness, optimality, and complexity.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate BFS and DFS exploring a search tree/graph with the frontier.

nodes.name: Heuristics and Admissibility
nodes.description: Heuristic functions estimating the cost to reach the goal, where admissibility (never overestimating) and consistency guarantee optimal informed search.

nodes.name: Informed Search (A*)
nodes.description: Informed search using heuristics to guide exploration, including greedy best-first and A*, which expands nodes by estimated total path cost.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate A* expanding nodes by f = g + h on a grid.

nodes.name: Adversarial Search (Minimax)
nodes.description: Adversarial search computing optimal play in zero-sum games by recursively assuming each player maximises its own outcome against an optimal opponent.
nodes.visual_hint: Step a minimax game tree backing up values from the leaves.

nodes.name: Alpha-Beta Pruning
nodes.description: An optimisation of minimax that prunes branches which cannot affect the final decision, allowing deeper search within the same time budget.
nodes.visual_hint: Step minimax with alpha-beta pruning, showing cut branches.

nodes.name: Constraint Satisfaction Problems
nodes.description: Constraint satisfaction problems defined by variables, domains, and constraints, seeking assignments that satisfy all constraints simultaneously.

nodes.name: Backtracking Search
nodes.description: A depth-first search for CSPs that assigns variables one at a time and backtracks when a constraint is violated, pruning the search tree.
nodes.visual_hint: Animate backtracking search assigning CSP variables and backing up on failure.

nodes.name: Constraint Propagation
nodes.description: Constraint propagation that prunes domain values inconsistent with constraints, with arc consistency and forward checking reducing search effort.

nodes.name: Local Search
nodes.description: Search that iteratively improves a complete assignment using local moves, such as hill climbing and min-conflicts, trading completeness for scalability.

nodes.name: Markov Decision Processes
nodes.description: Markov decision processes modelling sequential decisions under uncertainty with states, actions, stochastic transitions, rewards, and a discount factor.

nodes.name: Bellman Equations
nodes.description: The Bellman equations recursively expressing the optimal value of a state as the best expected immediate reward plus discounted future value.

nodes.name: Value Iteration
nodes.description: A dynamic-programming algorithm computing optimal MDP values by iteratively applying the Bellman update until the value function converges.
nodes.visual_hint: Iterate MDP state values on a grid until convergence.

nodes.name: Policy Iteration
nodes.description: An MDP algorithm alternating policy evaluation, computing a policy's values, with policy improvement, acting greedily, until the policy stabilises.

nodes.name: Reinforcement Learning Framework
nodes.description: Reinforcement learning, where an agent learns optimal behaviour by interacting with an unknown environment and receiving rewards, without a transition model.

nodes.name: Temporal Difference Learning
nodes.description: Temporal-difference learning updating value estimates from successive observations, bootstrapping from later estimates without waiting for final outcomes.

nodes.name: Q-Learning
nodes.description: A model-free, off-policy reinforcement-learning algorithm that learns optimal action values directly from experience, independent of the policy followed.
nodes.visual_hint: Update a Q-table as an agent moves through a gridworld.

nodes.name: Exploration vs Exploitation
nodes.description: The exploration-exploitation tradeoff balancing trying new actions to gain information against choosing currently best actions to maximise reward.

nodes.name: Approximate Q-Learning
nodes.description: Approximate Q-learning representing the value function with features and weights, generalising across states too numerous to store in a table.

nodes.name: Probability Fundamentals
nodes.description: Probability fundamentals for AI, including random variables, joint and marginal distributions, and independence, used to reason under uncertainty.

nodes.name: Bayes Rule
nodes.description: Bayes' rule inverting conditional probabilities to update beliefs about hypotheses given observed evidence, combining prior probabilities with likelihoods.

nodes.name: Bayesian Networks
nodes.description: Bayesian networks compactly representing a joint distribution as a directed acyclic graph that encodes conditional independence among variables.
nodes.visual_hint: Directed acyclic graph of a Bayesian network with conditional dependencies.

nodes.name: Inference in Bayes Nets
nodes.description: Inference in Bayesian networks computing posterior probabilities via exact methods like variable elimination or approximate sampling techniques.

nodes.name: Markov Models
nodes.description: Markov models representing stochastic state sequences satisfying the Markov property, where the next state depends only on the current state.

nodes.name: Hidden Markov Models
nodes.description: Hidden Markov models pairing an unobserved Markov state sequence with observations, used to infer hidden states from noisy evidence.
nodes.visual_hint: Trellis diagram of hidden states and observations over time.

nodes.name: Forward Algorithm
nodes.description: The forward algorithm computing the filtered belief over hidden states given the observations seen so far, via recursive probability updates.

nodes.name: Viterbi Algorithm
nodes.description: The Viterbi algorithm using dynamic programming to find the single most likely sequence of hidden states given an observation sequence.
nodes.visual_hint: Step the Viterbi trellis selecting the most likely hidden-state path.

nodes.name: Particle Filtering
nodes.description: Particle filtering approximating the belief over states with weighted samples, propagated and resampled to track distributions in large state spaces.

nodes.name: Naive Bayes
nodes.description: A simple probabilistic classifier applying Bayes' rule under the assumption that features are conditionally independent given the class label.

nodes.name: Perceptron
nodes.description: A linear classifier that learns a separating hyperplane by updating weights on misclassified examples via the perceptron learning rule.
nodes.visual_hint: Plot a linear decision boundary updating as the perceptron learns.

nodes.name: Neural Networks
nodes.description: Multilayer neural networks composing linear transformations with nonlinear activations to learn complex, nonlinear decision functions from data.
nodes.visual_hint: Diagram a multilayer network of weighted connections and activations.

nodes.name: Generalization and Overfitting
nodes.description: Generalisation describing how well a model performs on unseen data, with overfitting and model capacity governing the gap between training and test error.
